column1: Clause  2  :  This  clause  amends  section  3  of  the  Nation  Building  Tax  Act,  No.  9  of  2009
and  the  legal  effect  of  the  section  as  amended  is  to  limit  the  period  of  application  of  the
Nation  Building  Tax  under  the  said  Act  to  the  period  prior  to  December  1,  2019.
